summary: Refresh the local PaperDigHelper UI toward the supplied Dribbble reference: compact editorial layout, restrained surfaces, icon navigation, responsive sizing, and subtle view/card motion.
scope_note: User-requested visual refresh only. The supplied reference was manually inspected in a browser; the source site itself remains protected by an access challenge.

budget_impact.rationale: CSS, markup, vendored static icons and deterministic UI tests only; no model call or external runtime request added.
budget_impact.before: Existing local UI with layered neumorphic surfaces and text-only controls.
budget_impact.after: Compact responsive editorial layout with local Lucide SVG icons, reduced visual weight and view/card transitions. Model and provider behavior unchanged.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: Manual browser QA at normal zoom, dark mode, library/profile/detail views and enlarged browser text

open_risks: Visual similarity to the supplied reference is directional rather than pixel-identical.
Browser zoom is controlled by the browser; the app cannot force the user's zoom back to 100%.
